_what: RUNG 5b-T — the assembled inputs for the three paralogue arms
_status: INPUT CONSTRUCTION AND ITS PRE-FLIGHT. No prediction, no score, no claim.

docked_warhead._rule: nearest C5 nitrogen to the exit-vector anchor the E3 placement was sampled at; fixed before the run, not chosen on the outcome

embed._reading: both are RMSDs to the two supplied fragment poses, not to anything measured. They say how well the recorded molecule can bridge the modelled arrangement — nothing about affinity, and nothing about whether the arrangement is right.

snap_masks._why: `replace_to_unbound_coords` builds `cdist.min(dim=1)[0] < 1` and reduces over it; an empty mask is the RuntimeError that killed runs 30753431082 and 30754028742.

detail.gt_complex_is: assembly_frame_placeholder_not_ground_truth — there is NO native NR4A3 ternary. DockQ/LRMSD/fnat against this file are meaningless and the scorer refuses to compute them for a paralogue arm.
detail.protein1_is_also_unbound_protein1: the same matched opened LBD serves both slots, because there is no native ternary to take a bound conformer from. Stated rather than hidden: this arm supplies NO induced fit on the target side.

arm_C_inputs._note: C397 is NR4A3-unique; the comparator arms have no such cysteine, which is the categorical handle itself. Arm (C) is therefore measured on the NR4A3 arm only.

matched_superposition._note: Reported as global-vs-core deliberately. The global figure is dominated by a minority of terminal/loop positions that the two independently-built opened models genuinely place differently; the core figure is the one that says whether the fold-level frame is shared. Residues with a large post-fit deviation have UNRELIABLE positions in this frame and any claim about them is flagged accordingly.

placement._the_constraint: ⛔ THERE IS NO NATIVE NR4A3 TERNARY, so DeepTernary's published 'superpose both binaries into the native frame' step has no reference. This RUNG-5a orientation basin supplies the arrangement instead, and every result downstream is conditional on it. It does not leak into the prediction — `predict_one_unbound` randomly rotates and translates protein 2 and the ligand — but it decides whether the two-fragment embed is feasible at all.

receptor_entry.title: Crystal structure of DDB1-CRBN-BRD4(BD1) complex bound to dBET6 PROTAC.

e3_placement.\u26d4_provenance: 6BOY is a TERNARY (DDB1-CRBN-BRD4/dBET6). This placed copy is used ONLY as the frame onto which a BINARY IMiD deposit is superposed; its own conformer never reaches the model, precisely because a ternary-derived E3 imports that ternary's induced fit.

ligand._never: bond orders are SOURCED from the CCD, never perceived from the PDB — `MolFromPDBFile` reads CONECT as all-single and turns every carbonyl into an alcohol
